programmes.d: Hoppy investigates the mysterious deaths at the Last Chance Inn that are linked to one particular room.
Dion Patrick gets into a poker game with unusual stakes while trailing a killer.
Don Mariano Vallejo is suspected of leading raids on Yankee settlements.
Two outlaws (James Garner, Dennis Weaver) stage a prison break to steal a fortune in gold dust guarded by the Army.
A wagonmaster (Rod Cameron) bound for California has gunrunners and Indians to worry about.
A frontier woman (Raquel Welch) learns from a bounty hunter (Robert Culp) how to shoot the outlaws who have made her a widow.
A Texas gunfighter (Robert Mitchum) helps an old friend (Robert Preston) stir up a feud between ranchers and settlers.
An Army scout (Gregory Peck) rescues a white woman (Eva Marie Saint) and her half-Indian son from their renegade captors.
Lawman John Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) searches the U.S.-Mexico border for a Mexican peasant (Tomas Milian) accused of raping and killing a 12-year-old girl.
Prospectors combat the elements and one another in an attempt to retrieve a fortune in gold from the hills of Nevada.
A doctor (Gary Cooper) kills to save a blinded Swiss girl (Maria Schell) from a villain (Karl Malden) in a Montana gold-mining town.
Circumstances give a coward an opportunity to redeem himself.
A determined woman risks a range war to create a cattle empire.
A gun-happy youth and a restless woman haunt a reformed gunman.
A bounty hunter pursues a couple who have eloped.
A bully comes to his senses.
A man fears being forced to kill.

Bill is hired to drive a cattle herd to Abilene, but he must contend with two big problems: a hostile trail hand and a rival drive whose leader will stop at nothing to ensure that his herd gets to Abilene first.
After failing in an attempt to ambush Bill, Bishop pays a band of Native Americans to attack the Akins herd, hoping to scatter the cattle and prevent them from reaching Abilene first.
When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as the Thicket.
